title: Medial Clusters
intro: Select ႂ, ျ or ြ to explore medial clusters and their syllable examples.

items.label: Medial -w-
items.note: Medial wa joins an initial consonant to a w sound. Select the sign to see examples.

detail.title: Medial ႂ - -w-
detail.intro: Combine the initial consonant with ႂ, then add the vowel. These examples practise spelling without tone marks.

items.label: kwaa
items.note: Spelling practice: ၵ + ႂ + ႃ. Read the consonant and medial together before the vowel.

items.label: khwaa
items.note: Spelling practice: ၶ + ႂ + ႃ. Compare the aspirated initial kh with k in ၵႂႃ.

items.label: Medial -y-
items.note: Medial ya represents a y /j/ sound in clusters, mostly in loanwords. Select the sign to see examples.

detail.title: Medial ျ - -y-
detail.intro: Combine the initial consonant with ျ, then add the vowel. This medial is mostly used in loanwords. The example practises spelling without tone marks.

items.label: kyaa
items.note: Spelling practice: ၵ + ျ + ႃ. Compare the medial y sign with the medial w sign in ၵႂႃ.

items.label: Medial -r-
items.note: Medial ra represents an r sound in clusters, mostly in loanwords. Select the sign to see examples.

detail.title: Medial ြ - -r-
detail.intro: Combine the initial consonant with ြ, then add the vowel. In Shan this medial represents r and is mostly used in loanwords. These examples practise spelling without tone marks.

items.label: kraa
items.note: Spelling practice: ၵ + ြ + ႃ. Compare with ၵႂႃ and ၵျႃ.

items.label: traa
items.note: Spelling practice: တ + ြ + ႃ. Read the initial t and medial r together before the vowel.
